BiblicalUsage: Shobjah appears once, in Benjamin's genealogy, listed among the sons of Shaharaim, where the King James Version spells the name Shachia. He is one of the heads of the fathers' houses, and nothing more is told about him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in a genealogy is still a person God knew. Shobjah's line is recorded, and that is enough to say he belonged.
